title: 介词后接 doing

examples.en: He is good at playing basketball.

guess.question: at、for 后面的动词为什么要加 -ing？

options.text: 因为 at、for 是介词，介词后面的动词一律用 doing
options.feedback: 对！介词后面如果要跟动词，只能用动名词，这是一条硬规则。
不对——at、for 在这里是介词，不是动词。
不对——这里没有 be 动词，不是进行时，是介词宾语。

rule.rule: 介词后面的动词一律用 doing（动名词作介词宾语）
rule.formula: 介词 + doing：be good at doing / be interested in doing / thanks for doing / what about doing / be afraid of doing

anchors.en: She is interested in collecting stamps.
Thanks for inviting me to your party.
anchors.zh: 谢谢你邀请我参加你的聚会。

trap.wrong: He is good at play basketball.
trap.right: He is good at playing basketball.
trap.why: at 是介词，后面要接 playing，不能接原形。
